newsitem.title: USA: FAA allows ValuJet to add to its fleet.
newsitem.headline: FAA allows ValuJet to add to its fleet.

text.p: The Federal Aviation Administration on Tuesday said it had authorized ValuJet Inc to add an additional DC-9 jet aircraft to its fleet.
This allows ValuJet to expand its fleet to 19 aircraft, all DC-9s.
The approval for the additional aircraft follows a complete records review and other checks by the airline regulator, it said.
The FAA said that ValuJet had applied on November 15 for authority to add five aircraft to its fleet.
It was given permission on Jan 8 to add three aircraft but approval was withheld on the two remaining airliners pending documents reviews and conformity checks.
It said that its action on Tuesday releases one of those aircraft for service while further checks continue on the fifth aircraft.
